title: Music to My Ears
summary: A pianist is found shot dead in his house. The initials written by the victim as a dying message link back to a criminal who passed away in a car accident 20 years ago. Catherine gets attacked at the end, leading Camille to return the next episode.
notes: Florence goes away to the UK to investigate the original car accident case 20 years ago. Camille makes an appearance at the end as a sergeant in France.
